extension.summary: MegaNexus image or animation, custom image/GIF or looping silent video screensaver.
extension.description: Shows the MegaNexus logo, still or animated by the skin (no video player), or use custom artwork or a local/shared MP4, MKV, WebM, MOV and other supported video file. Video mode preserves paused media by falling back to artwork. Follows the shared weather and clock visibility preference.
